1.english_reference: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah

traditions.WLC: בִּ שְׁנַת֙ שְׁבַֽע עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לְ פֶ֖קַח בֶּן רְמַלְיָ֑הוּ
traditions.LXX: Ἐν ἔτει ἑπτακαιδεκάτῳ Φάκεε υἱοῦ Ῥομελίου
traditions.VUL: Anno décimo séptimo Phácee fílii Romelíæ ,
traditions.KJV: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah

1.english_reference: Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign

traditions.WLC: מָלַ֛ךְ אָחָ֥ז בֶּן יוֹתָ֖ם מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
traditions.LXX: ἐβασίλευσεν Ἀχὰζ υἱὸς Ἰωαθὰμ βασιλέως Ἰούδα .
traditions.VUL: regnávit Achaz fílius Ióatham regis Iuda .
traditions.KJV: Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign .

2.english_reference: Twenty years old [ was ] Ahaz when he began to reign

traditions.WLC: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ אָחָ֣ז בְּ מָלְכ֔ וֹ

traditions.VUL: Vigínti annórum erat Achaz cum regnáre cœpísset ,
traditions.KJV: Twenty years old [ was ] Ahaz when he began to reign ,

2.english_reference: and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וְ שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἑκκαίδεκα ἔτη ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ ·
traditions.VUL: et sédecim annis regnávit in Ierúsalem :
traditions.KJV: and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem ,

2.english_reference: and did not [ that which was ] right in the sight of the LORD his God , like David his father

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹא עָשָׂ֣ה הַ יָּשָׁ֗ר בְּ עֵינֵ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָ֖י ו כְּ דָוִ֥ד אָבִֽי ו
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἐποίησεν τὸ εὐθὲς ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς Κυρίου θεοῦ πιστῶς ὡς Δαυεὶδ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ .

traditions.KJV: and did not [ that which was ] right in the sight of the LORD his God , like David his father .

3.english_reference: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֕לֶךְ בְּ דֶ֖רֶךְ מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἐν ὁδῷ βασιλέως Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: sed ambulávit in via regum Israel :
traditions.KJV: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel ,

3.english_reference: yea , and made his son to pass through the fire

traditions.WLC: וְ גַ֤ם אֶת בְּנ וֹ֙ הֶעֱבִ֣יר בָּ אֵ֔שׁ
traditions.LXX: καί γε τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ διῆγεν πυρὶ
traditions.VUL: ínsuper et fílium suum consecrávit , tránsferens per ignem
traditions.KJV: yea , and made his son to pass through the fire ,

3.english_reference: according to the abominations of the heathen , whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel

traditions.WLC: כְּ תֹֽעֲבוֹת֙ הַ גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹרִ֤ישׁ יְהוָה֙ אֹתָ֔ ם מִ פְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὰ βδελύγματα τῶν ἐθνῶν ὧν ἐξῆρεν Κύριος ἀπὸ προσώπου τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: secúndum idóla géntium , quæ dissipávit Dóminus coram fíliis Israel .
traditions.KJV: according to the abominations of the heathen , whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel .

4.english_reference: And he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places

traditions.WLC: וַ יְזַבֵּ֧חַ וַ יְקַטֵּ֛ר בַּ בָּמ֖וֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐθυσίαζεν καὶ ἐθυμία ἐν τοῖς ὑψηλοῖς
traditions.VUL: Immolábat quoque víctimas , et adolébat incénsum in excélsis ,
traditions.KJV: And he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places ,

traditions.WLC: וְ עַל הַ גְּבָע֑וֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν βουνῶν
traditions.VUL: et in cóllibus ,
traditions.KJV: and on the hills ,

traditions.WLC: וְ תַ֖חַת כָּל עֵ֥ץ רַעֲנָֽן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὑποκάτω παντὸς ξύλου ἀλσώδους .
traditions.VUL: et sub omni ligno frondóso .
traditions.KJV: and under every green tree .

5.english_reference: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to war

traditions.WLC: אָ֣ז יַעֲלֶ֣ה רְצִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ אֲ֠רָם וּ פֶ֨קַח בֶּן רְמַלְיָ֧הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לַ מִּלְחָמָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: Τότε ἀνέβη Ῥαασσὼν βασιλεὺς Συρίας καὶ Φάκεε υἱὸς Ῥομελίου βασιλεὺς Ἰσραὴλ εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ εἰς πόλεμον
traditions.VUL: Tunc ascéndit Rasin rex Sýriæ , et Phácee fílius Romelíæ rex Israel , in Ierúsalem ad prœliándum :

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּצֻ֨רוּ֙ עַל אָחָ֔ז
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπολιόρκουν ἐπὶ Ἀχάζ ,

traditions.KJV: and they besieged Ahaz ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֥א יָכְל֖וּ לְ הִלָּחֵֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἐδύναντο πολεμεῖν .
traditions.VUL: non valuérunt superáre eum .
traditions.KJV: but could not overcome [ him ] .

6.english_reference: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria

traditions.WLC: בָּ עֵ֣ת הַ הִ֗יא הֵ֠שִׁיב רְצִ֨ין מֶֽלֶךְ אֲרָ֤ם אֶת אֵילַת֙ לַֽ אֲרָ֔ם
traditions.LXX: ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ ἐπέστρεψεν Ῥαασσὼν βασιλεὺς Συρίας τὴν Αἰλὰθ τῇ Συρίᾳ ,
traditions.VUL: In témpore illo restítuit Rasin rex Sýriæ , Ailam Sýriæ ,
traditions.KJV: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria ,

6.english_reference: and drave the Jews from Elath

traditions.WLC: וַ יְנַשֵּׁ֥ל אֶת הַ יְהוּדִ֖ים מֵֽ אֵיל֑וֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξέβαλεν τοὺς Ἰουδαίους ἐξ Αἰλάθ ,
traditions.VUL: et eiécit Iudǽos de Aila :
traditions.KJV: and drave the Jews from Elath :

6.english_reference: and the Syrians came to Elath , and dwelt there unto this day

traditions.WLC: ו ארמים בָּ֣אוּ אֵילַ֔ת וַ יֵּ֣שְׁבוּ שָׁ֔ם עַ֖ד הַ יּ֥וֹם הַ זֶּֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ἰδουμαῖοι ἦλθον εἰς Αἰλὰθ καὶ κατῴκησαν ἐκεῖ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης .
traditions.VUL: et Idumǽi venérunt in Ailam , et habitavérunt ibi usque in diem hanc .
traditions.KJV: and the Syrians came to Elath , and dwelt there unto this day .

7.english_reference: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglathpileser king of Assyria , saying

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁלַ֨ח אָחָ֜ז מַלְאָכִ֗ים אֶל תִּ֠גְלַת פְּלֶ֤סֶר מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר֙ לֵ אמֹ֔ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Ἀχὰζ ἀγγέλους πρὸς Θαλγαθφελλασὰρ βασιλέα Ἀσσυρίων λέγων
traditions.VUL: Misit autem Achaz núntios ad Theglathphálasar regem Assyriórum , dicens :
traditions.KJV: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglathpileser king of Assyria , saying ,

7.english_reference: I [ am ] thy servant and thy son

traditions.WLC: עַבְדְּ ךָ֥ וּ בִנְ ךָ֖ אָ֑נִי
traditions.LXX: Δοῦλός σου καὶ υἱός σου ἐγώ .
traditions.VUL: Servus tuus , et fílius tuus ego sum :
traditions.KJV: I [ am ] thy servant and thy son :

7.english_reference: come up , and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria , and out of the hand of the king of Israel , which rise up against me

traditions.WLC: עֲלֵ֨ה וְ הוֹשִׁעֵ֜ נִי מִ כַּ֣ף מֶֽלֶךְ אֲרָ֗ם וּ מִ כַּף֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַ קּוֹמִ֖ים עָלָֽ י
traditions.LXX: ἀνάβηθι , σῶσόν με ἐκ χειρὸς βασιλέως Συρίας καὶ ἐκ χειρὸς βασιλέως Ἰσραὴλ τῶν ἐπανισταμένων ἐπ᾽ ἐμέ .
traditions.VUL: ascénde , et salvum me fac de manu regis Sýriæ , et de manu regis Israel , qui consurrexérunt advérsum me .
traditions.KJV: come up , and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria , and out of the hand of the king of Israel , which rise up against me .

8.english_reference: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the LORD , and in the treasures of the king ’s house

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקַּ֨ח אָחָ֜ז אֶת הַ כֶּ֣סֶף וְ אֶת הַ זָּהָ֗ב הַ נִּמְצָא֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וּ בְ אֹֽצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֣ית הַ מֶּ֑לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔλαβεν Ἀχὰζ ἀργύριον καὶ χρυσίον τὸ εὑρεθὲν ἐν θησαυροῖς οἴκου Κυρίου καὶ οἴκου τοῦ βασιλέως
traditions.VUL: Et cum collegísset argéntum et aurum , quod inveníri pótuit in domo Dómini , et in thesáuris regis ,
traditions.KJV: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the LORD , and in the treasures of the king ’s house ,

8.english_reference: and sent [ it for ] a present to the king of Assyria

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁלַ֥ח לְ מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁ֖וּר שֹֽׁחַד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν τῷ βασιλεῖ δῶρα .
traditions.VUL: misit regi Assyriórum múnera .
traditions.KJV: and sent [ it for ] a present to the king of Assyria .

9.english_reference: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁמַ֤ע אֵלָי ו֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἤκουσεν αὐτοῦ βασιλεὺς Ἀσσυρίων ·
traditions.VUL: Qui et acquiévit voluntáti eius :
traditions.KJV: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him :

9.english_reference: for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus , and took it

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּעַל֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ אַשּׁ֤וּר אֶל דַּמֶּ֨שֶׂק֙ וַֽ יִּתְפְּשֶׂ֔ הָ

traditions.KJV: for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus , and took it ,

9.english_reference: and carried [ the people of ] it captive to Kir

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּגְלֶ֖ הָ קִ֑ירָ ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπῴκισεν αὐτήν ,
traditions.VUL: et tránstulit habitatóres eius Cyrénen :
traditions.KJV: and carried [ the people of ] it captive to Kir ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת רְצִ֖ין הֵמִֽית
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸν Ῥαασσὼν ἐθανάτωσεν .
traditions.VUL: Rasin autem interfécit .
traditions.KJV: and slew Rezin .

10.english_reference: And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglathpileser king of Assyria

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֣לֶךְ הַ מֶּ֣לֶךְ אָחָ֡ז לִ֠ קְרַאת תִּגְלַ֨ת פִּלְאֶ֤סֶר מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר֙ דּוּמֶּ֔שֶׂק
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐπορεύθη βασιλεὺς Ἀχὰζ εἰς ἀπαντὴν αὐτοῦ τῷ Θαλγαλφελλασὰρ βασιλεῖ Ἀσσυρίων εἰς Δαμασκόν ·
traditions.VUL: Perrexítque rex Achaz in occúrsum Theglathphálasar regis Assyriórum in Damáscum :
traditions.KJV: And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglathpileser king of Assyria ,

10.english_reference: and saw an altar that [ was ] at Damascus

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֥רְא אֶת הַ מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ דַמָּ֑שֶׂק

traditions.VUL: cumque vidísset altáre Damásci ,
traditions.KJV: and saw an altar that [ was ] at Damascus :

10.english_reference: and king Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the fashion of the altar , and the pattern of it , according to all the workmanship thereof

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁלַח֩ הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ אָחָ֜ז אֶל אוּרִיָּ֣ה הַ כֹּהֵ֗ן אֶת דְּמ֧וּת הַ מִּזְבֵּ֛חַ וְ אֶת תַּבְנִית֖ וֹ לְ כָֽל מַעֲשֵֽׂ הוּ

traditions.VUL: misit rex Achaz ad Uríam sacerdótem exémplar eius , et similitúdinem iuxta omne opus eius .
traditions.KJV: and king Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the fashion of the altar , and the pattern of it , according to all the workmanship thereof .

11.english_reference: And Urijah the priest built an altar

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּ֛בֶן אוּרִיָּ֥ה הַ כֹּהֵ֖ן אֶת הַ מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ

traditions.VUL: Exstruxítque Urías sacérdos altáre :
traditions.KJV: And Urijah the priest built an altar

11.english_reference: according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus

traditions.WLC: כְּ כֹ֣ל אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַח֩ הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ אָחָ֜ז מִ דַּמֶּ֗שֶׂק
traditions.LXX: κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἀπέστειλεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ἀχὰζ ἐκ Δαμασκοῦ .
traditions.VUL: iuxta ómnia quæ præcéperat rex Achaz de Damásco ,
traditions.KJV: according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus :

traditions.WLC: כֵּ֤ן עָשָׂה֙ אוּרִיָּ֣ה הַ כֹּהֵ֔ן עַד בּ֥וֹא הַ מֶּֽלֶךְ אָחָ֖ז מִ דַּמָּֽשֶׂק
traditions.VUL: ita fecit sacérdos Urías donec veníret rex Achaz de Damásco .
traditions.KJV: so Urijah the priest made [ it ] against king Ahaz came from Damascus .

12.english_reference: And when the king was come from Damascus

traditions.VUL: Cumque venísset rex de Damásco ,
traditions.KJV: And when the king was come from Damascus ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֥רְא הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֶת הַ מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶδεν ὁ βασιλεὺς τὸ θυσιαστήριον ,
traditions.VUL: vidit altáre ,
traditions.KJV: the king saw the altar :

12.english_reference: and the king approached to the altar, and offered thereon

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקְרַ֥ב הַ מֶּ֛לֶךְ עַל הַ מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ וַ יַּ֥עַל עָלָֽי ו

traditions.KJV: and the king approached to the altar , and offered thereon .

13.english_reference: And he burnt his burnt offering and his meat offering

traditions.VUL: et libávit libámina ,
traditions.KJV: And he burnt his burnt offering and his meat offering ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּסֵּ֖ךְ אֶת נִסְכּ֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὴν σπονδὴν αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.KJV: and poured his drink offering ,

13.english_reference: and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings , upon the altar

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּזְרֹ֛ק אֶת דַּֽם הַ שְּׁלָמִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר ל֖ וֹ עַל הַ מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
traditions.LXX: καὶ προσέχεεν τὸ αἷμα τῶν εἰρηνικῶν τῶν αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον
traditions.VUL: et fudit sánguinem pacificórum , quæ obtúlerat super altáre .
traditions.KJV: and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings , upon the altar .

14.english_reference: And he brought also the brasen altar , which [ was ] before the LORD

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵ֨ת הַ מִּזְבַּ֣ח הַ נְּחֹשֶׁת֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִ פְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֒
traditions.LXX: τὸ χαλκοῦν τὸ ἀπέναντι Κυρίου
traditions.VUL: Porro altáre ǽreum , quod erat coram Dómino ,
traditions.KJV: And he brought also the brasen altar , which [ was ] before the LORD ,
